description: Line parity of the Neuralese stages (owner 2026-10-11: the Mellum line on DGX and the LFM line on Pop use the same recipe, data and code; settings may differ only to fit, or where the backbone requires it, each declared with its reason). natlang_neuralese.train.line_parity checks it in scripts/check-main.sh --quick; plans/neuralese/LINE_PARITY.md holds the audit. stages.<stage>.lines.<line>.recipe names the recipe of the line's NEXT launch; a direct-stage recipe that declares "parity": {"line", "stage"} is checked the same way, and the direct-stage runner refuses a fresh neuralese_direct or direct-artifact recurrence launch without a parity declaration.

acceptance.description: The shared E2E acceptance is the base recipe's e2e_acceptance (neuralese-e2e-v1; train/e2e_acceptance.py writes e2e-certificate.json; compared across lines as e2e_acceptance.*): consumers reading values (V) against consumers reading the gold tokens (T) on the same held producer calls, V CE at most T CE, V beats shuffled and zeroed blocks by 0.05 nats, at least 32 paired readers; exact-oracle task success, V at most 0.02 below T; no drift stop. Reported only: the 48-probe behaviour gate (owner 2026-10-12), the token-readout regression (eval/direct_token_readout.py, held-consumer arm, penalty 0.05 nats), the greedy-T arm. Runtime qualification of the exact starting weights is the lineage's first stage (direct_runtime).

historical_differences.difference: Mellum's completed warm-up (runs/neuralese-direct-mellum-20261011/run-v3/direct_warmup, 333 updates, 0.5 epoch) used the 4962 full-prompt set (3,258 train documents, Mellum twin) while LFM's warm-up uses the union r2 full rendering (66k train documents)
historical_differences.reason: coordinator decision 2026-10-12 (agreed by Pop, pop-86dc): the finished warm-up is not redone; Mellum continues into neuralese-direct-mellum-v4's direct_sft and direct_trajectory on union r2. Not backbone-inherent and not a precedent: the parity recipe neuralese-direct-mellum-v4 keeps the r2 warm-up for the next fresh launch.

historical_differences.difference: Mellum v4's direct_trajectory phase (1 epoch) reads union r3's whole-trajectory rendering (runs/natlang-target-union-20261011-r3/whole-trajectory/mellum21, 165,822 train / 1,549 test documents, 50.2M supervised tokens) while the parity recipes (neuralese-direct-v3, neuralese-direct-mellum-v4) keep union r2's (75,983 / 123, 15.9M)
historical_differences.reason: coordinator decision 2026-10-12: union r3 was registered while v4's direct_sft ran; the not-yet-started phase takes it by --handoff (recipe.py unstarted_stage_input_changes). The LFM line moves to r3 by its own decision (briefed to Pop); once both lines read r3, the parity base moves and this entry is removed.

historical_differences.difference: Mellum v4's direct_sft trained curriculum 0 to about 0.03 on the earlier allocation (direct_sft [0, 0.35]) and moves to the shared one (direct_sft [0, 0.75]) by an objective continuation at its next --handoff, from its value at that update; the shared nested-family objective joins there (ramp from 0.05, so from zero). A fresh parity launch runs both from update 0
historical_differences.reason: owner decision 2026-10-12 (REVIEW_20261012 rec. 4: QAT ramps the stages actually reach, nested family reinstated in the running lineage, no restart). Shared mechanism (recipe objective_continuation, direct_sft.objective_continuation); a running LFM lineage without a curriculum takes it the same way, its curriculum then starting at its handoff update

historical_differences.difference: Mellum v4's direct_sft moves from union r2's program-header rendering to r3's (runs/natlang-target-union-20261011-r3/program-header/mellum21) by a data continuation (continued_text_data = the r2 file): it keeps its update counter, weights, MuonSR and QAT state; the r2 documents of its consumed updates count as seen and the rest of its 1 epoch is r3 minus them; held windows come from r3's test split. The parity recipes start direct_sft fresh on r2
historical_differences.reason: owner decision 2026-10-12 ("continue our training from what we have with more data"). The mechanism is shared (neuralese_direct handler role continued_text_data, direct_sft data_continuation; plans/neuralese/NEURALESE_DIRECT_V1.md), and the LFM line can take it the same way; a lineage-specific declaration, not a parity default.

the base-model source of a fresh lineage: LFM starts from LiquidAI's QAD full-precision LFM2.5-350M (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-350M-GGUF/qad rev 657e078c; owner 2026-10-12 via Pop pop-7fe7), Mellum from BF16 Mellum2.1-12B-A2.5B-Thinking (owner 2026-10-09). A resume keeps its checkpoint

Mellum's lower deploy precisions beyond the shared q4 point (ternary-experts required, ternary report): the 12B MoE deploys ternary experts, LFM2.5-350M deploys Q4 (Q4_K_M browser default). The q4 ramp differs with the base weights: LFM starts from QAD weights (q4 ramp 0.25-0.3), Mellum from plain BF16 (0.15-0.3). Curriculum (stage_progress) and loss are shared (owner 2026-10-12: light QAT on LFM, same mechanism and ramp shape)
